shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin and Ethereum prices dropped significantly as Bitcoin ETFs saw outflows of $1 billion last week.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index fell to 28, indicating a shift into fear among market participants.
Escalating geopolitical tensions and US inflation concerns are contributing to a broad risk-off environment.
The Verus-Ethereum Bridge was exploited for approximately $11.5 million, highlighting ongoing security risks.
